genesis.19.p1.b1.text: Now the two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city.

genesis.19.p1.b2.text: My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.

genesis.19.p1.b3.text: No … we will spend the night in the square.

genesis.19.p1.b4.text: But Lot insisted so strongly that they followed him into his house. … baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

genesis.19.p2.b5.text: Before they had gone to bed, all the men of the city of Sodom, both young and old, surrounded the house.

genesis.19.p2.b6.text: Where are the men who came to you tonight? Send them out to us …

genesis.19.p2.b7.text: Lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.

genesis.19.p2.b8.text: Please, my brothers … don’t do such a wicked thing!

genesis.19.p3.b9.text: Get out of the way! … This one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge!

genesis.19.p3.b10.text: And they pressed in on Lot and moved in to break down the door.

genesis.19.p3.b11.text: But the men inside reached out, pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.

genesis.19.p3.b12.text: And they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door.

genesis.19.p4.b13.text: Do you have anyone else here … Get them out of here,

genesis.19.p4.b14.text: because we are about to destroy this place. …

genesis.19.p4.b15.text: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters.

genesis.19.p4.b16.text: Get up … Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!

genesis.19.p4.b17.text: But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.

genesis.19.p5.b18.text: Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.

genesis.19.p5.b20.text: the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of the LORD’s compassion for them.

genesis.19.p6.b21.text: Run for your lives! Do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! Flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!

genesis.19.p6.b22.text: No, my lords, please! … But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.

genesis.19.p6.b23.text: Look, there is a town nearby where I can flee, and it is a small place. Please let me flee there—is it not a small place?

genesis.19.p6.b24.text: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.

genesis.19.p6.b25.text: That is why the town was called Zoar.

genesis.19.p7.b26.text: And by the time the sun had risen over the land, Lot had reached Zoar.

genesis.19.p7.b27.text: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.

genesis.19.p7.b28.text: Thus He destroyed these cities and the entire plain, including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground.

genesis.19.p8.b29.text: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

genesis.19.p8.b30.text: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.

genesis.19.p8.b31.text: and he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace.

genesis.19.p8.b32.text: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe …

genesis.19.p9.b33.text: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains—for he was afraid to stay in Zoar—where they lived in a cave.

genesis.19.p9.b34.text: Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth. … and preserve his line.

genesis.19.p9.b35.text: So that night they got their father drunk with wine … he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.

genesis.19.p9.b36.text: The next day … So again that night they got their father drunk with wine … he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.

genesis.19.p10.b37.text: Thus both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.

genesis.19.p10.b38.text: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.

genesis.19.p10.b39.text: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites of today.
